steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?
Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In January 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said AIC Mines was making really good money at current copper prices, noting the project was a little deep but execution under its CEO had been strong.

episode.title: Why 2026 is the Year of Resources - Luke Laretive

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In January 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said there was lots of scope for AIC Mines to be a consolidator, while also being a likely acquisition target for large international miners based on conversations late last year.

episode.title: Why 2026 is the Year of Resources - Luke Laretive

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In January 2026, a guest on Equity Mates suggested interest from large miners, viewing AIC Mines as a top acquisition target, indicated there was value seen in the business even if no takeover occurred.

episode.title: Why 2026 is the Year of Resources - Luke Laretive
